paragraphs.text: Keep Context Current Through Meaningful Events.
Use controlled events and webhooks to keep permitted operating context and already-authorized workflows progressing across LAMID ONE and external systems without requiring the user to be present.

sections.label: Notify an External System After Approval
sections.title: Notify an External System After Approval

paragraphs.text: Notify an External System After Approval
Receive the approved workflow event, verify the signature, process once, and return a successful acknowledgement.
Use signed events, retry handling, idempotency, observable failures, event timestamps, permission checks, and replay controls so persistent progression remains dependable, bounded, and traceable.
